meta.description: Read, write, and convert multiple sequence alignment files using Biopython Bio.AlignIO. Supports Clustal, PHYLIP, Stockholm, FASTA, Nexus, and other alignment formats for phylogenetics and conservation analysis. Use when reading, writing, or converting alignment file formats.
meta.audit_type: re-audit (second) of the fixed Skill fix/al-io2; regression of the archived first re-audit inputs plus two new inputs (5 and 8)
meta.execution_note: Executed 8/8 inputs. Windows venv (Biopython 1.88, pyhmmer 0.12.3) plus WSL tools: MAFFT 7.526, HMMER 3.4, Infernal 1.1.5, HH-suite reformat.pl/hhfilter, RAxML-NG 1.2.2 and 2.0.3, PhyML 3.3.20220408 and 3.3.20260528, IQ-TREE 3.1.3, MrBayes 3.2.7, PAML 4.10.10, Foldmason. Shipped examples ran from copies; no __pycache__ in the worktree or the external clone. Previous (first re-audit) result: 85 Limited Release, 32/39 assertions.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated DOI, statistic or result. Every tool claim in the corrected dialect table (RAxML-NG star handling and name rejection, PhyML name handling on two builds, IQ-TREE checks, MrBayes quoted-id failure) reproduced on the real tools. The Rfam/Pfam/HBB/UniProt data used are real; synthetic injections are labelled.

practice_boundaries.detail: File-format and phylogenetics-input skill; no diagnostic or prescriptive content.

methodological_ground.detail: No principled methodological fallacy. The example's alphabet heuristic (>= 90% ACGTUN) is a documented approximation, not a fallacy; its silent mislabel of nucleotide alignments with >10% IUPAC/X letters is recorded as a P2 silent-wrong edge case (input 8).

code_usability.detail: All 20 Python blocks in SKILL.md and all 4 shipped examples parse and ran (Batch block now runs verbatim without a pre-existing converted/); the MrBayes recipe block executed verbatim and its output loaded in MrBayes 3.2.7 (DNA, protein, RNA).

functional_suitability.note: Completeness 4, correctness 3, appropriateness 4. Round 2 corrected the two false tool claims and added the MrBayes recipe; remaining imprecision: the MrBayes explanation covers only quoted ids (unquoted pipe ids also fail), the sanitiser regex leaves [ ], Clustal 30-char truncation is not mentioned.

reliability.note: Common Errors rows reproduce exactly; examples refuse bad input. Gaps: alphabet inference mislabels nucleotide data with >10% IUPAC/X as protein, mixed T/U writes an unreadable NEXUS labelled dna, an RNA-vs-DNA override raises a Biopython traceback after fasta/phy were already written.

performance_context.note: 472 lines / ~3,300 words in one SKILL.md with no references/ layer; usage-guide.md is a 54-line pointer.

agent_usability.note: Goal/Approach blocks, version stamps, MAF ground-truth loop, IQ-TREE zero-iteration check, datatype assert in the example. Error prevention lacks Clustal id truncation and the [ ] names.

human_usability.note: Natural example prompts; format choice is table-driven; the example's single failure message for unknown override is clear, the RNA/DNA mismatch message is a traceback.

security.note: No credentials, eval/exec, shell or network. Examples write output.* and converted/ into the cwd and overwrite silently.

maintainability.note: Version-stamped with the downstream tool versions; every changed claim re-verified in this audit; single file; examples verifiable from a clean copy.

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger, all cross-referenced Skills and neff.py exist, safe re-runs; no references/ layer.

recommendations.title: Alphabet inference mislabels IUPAC/X-heavy and mixed T/U data
recommendations.problem: convert_formats.py counts only ACGTUN, so a nucleotide alignment with more than 10% R/Y/K/M/S/W or X is written as datatype=protein with exit 0, and a mixed T+U alignment is written as datatype=dna into a NEXUS that AlignIO cannot re-read.
recommendations.root_cause: The 90% ACGTUN threshold ignores the other IUPAC nucleotide letters and the post-write assert only greps the datatype line.
recommendations.fix: Count ACGTUNRYKMSWBDHV as nucleotide, exit with a message when both T and U occur, and re-read output.nex before printing the check line.

recommendations.title: RNA/DNA override mismatch ends in a traceback and a 0-byte NEXUS
recommendations.problem: Overriding RNA on a T-containing alignment (or DNA on a U-containing one) is not caught by the example's guard; Biopython raises after output.fasta and output.phy are written and leaves output.nex empty.
recommendations.root_cause: The mismatch guard compares only protein against nucleotide.
recommendations.fix: Reject an override whose alphabet contradicts the inferred DNA or RNA before writing anything.

recommendations.title: Clustal 30-character id truncation is not documented
recommendations.problem: The Clustal writer silently cuts ids to 30 characters and returns two ids that differ only after character 30 as identical, unlike PHYLIP which raises; the SKILL documents only PHYLIP name limits while all shipped examples use Clustal.
recommendations.root_cause: Format-specific notes cover PHYLIP truncation only.
recommendations.fix: Add one sentence to the Format Coverage Map or Format-Specific Notes: Clustal writer truncates ids to 30 characters with no collision check; check id uniqueness after a Clustal round trip.

recommendations.title: MrBayes explanation and example miss unquoted pipe ids
recommendations.problem: The shipped example writes NEXUS with ids such as sp|P02185|MYG_PHYMC and lcl|NM_000518.5 unquoted and MrBayes 3.2.7 rejects them (Unrecognized character '|'), which is not the quoted-id failure the SKILL describes; the recipe fixes both.
recommendations.root_cause: The SKILL attributes the MrBayes failure to Biopython quoting only, and convert_formats.py does not apply the recipe.
recommendations.fix: State that MrBayes needs ids of [A-Za-z0-9_] only (quoted or not) and either apply the recipe in convert_formats.py or print a warning when ids contain other characters.

recommendations.title: Sanitiser regex [():,] leaves square brackets
recommendations.problem: A name containing [ is rejected by RAxML-NG 2.0.3 and makes PhyML 3.3.20260528 exit 139 after the initial tree, but the PHYLIP dialect table tells the agent to sanitise with [():,].
recommendations.root_cause: The table's fix regex lists the characters found in earlier probes only.
recommendations.fix: Point the table's fix cells at the recipe regex [^A-Za-z0-9_] used for MrBayes.

recommendations.title: SKILL.md is one 472-line file with no references/ layer
recommendations.problem: MAF, A2M/A3M, Stockholm and pyhmmer streaming sections sit in the main file, so every load pays for all of them.
recommendations.fix: Move MAF coordinates, A2M/A3M conventions and streaming into references/ files and link them from the Format Coverage Map.
